create_navigation_episode: create a NavigationEpisode with start position, rotation quaternion, and list of NavigationGoal targets
build_pointgoal_sensor: build a PointGoalSensor to compute cartesian or polar goal observations for navigation agents
implement_spl_measure: implement the SPL measure to calculate success weighted by path length for navigation evaluation
register_navigation_task: register a NavigationTask with the Habitat registry to define embodied navigation episodes and goals
create_velocity_action: create a VelocityAction to control agent linear and angular velocity with configurable speed ranges
